option_macros.description: Advanced timer used for three-phase PWM and ADC triggering. H533RE LQFP64 uses TIM1 in the canonical IOC.
TIM3 supplies native ABZ encoder capture on the H533RE canonical pin map.
ST-Link VCP baud rate used by the STM32 DL reference and H533RE hardware acceptance.

requirements.description: PWM auto-reload value for a 20 kHz center-aligned timer at 250 MHz.
Advanced-timer dead-time register value for this target.
Circular UART receive GPDMA buffer size.
